title: Ideation Capture
summary: An agent-managed capability that captures, preserves, develops, and reconnects ideas from natural human activity without requiring the human to operate schemas or recordkeeping workflows.

lifecycle.status_note: Purpose and separation from audiobook cognition detection are adopted; implementation details remain open.

relationships.note: Ideation Capture is independent of sleep state; the audiobook application is a separate concept to be memorialized through this capability.
Session Continuity Objects can transport working state but do not own this concept's domain truth.
Cassandra may render chronological and interpretive views from captured activity.

provenance.contribution: Separated Ideation Capture from the Apple Watch-enabled audiobook cognition/sleep-detection application and directed that the first be used to memorialize the second.
Directed a workflow reset that preserves schemas as an agent-managed abstraction layer while making rich human-facing documents the normal interface.
Provides the governing workflow and authority boundaries for this object and its dossier.

payload.intent: Make idea capture effortless for the human while preserving enough structure, provenance, and continuity for agents to develop ideas reliably across sessions, devices, models, and tools.

included: Documents, links, images, whiteboards, and journal pages
Progressive enrichment, dossier rendering, and migrate-on-touch reconciliation
excluded: Automatic adoption of doctrine or consequential decisions
Requiring humans to author or maintain JSON

operating_model: Capture the contribution and its provenance.
Resolve whether it extends an existing concept identity.
Apply the minimum useful structure for its maturity.
Update relationships, lifecycle, and open questions.
Render or update the primary human-facing dossier.
Request confirmation only for consequential changes.
confirmation_required_for: Adoption of doctrine or a material decision
Material change to scope, meaning, ownership, or authority
Resolution of a genuine ambiguity between competing concept identities
expected_outputs: Traceable decisions, assertions, evidence, questions, and actions
Specialized reports, specifications, presentations, or implementation artifacts when warranted
open_questions: Which capture channels should be implemented first after conversation and files?
What confidence threshold allows automatic concept matching without human interruption?
Which dossier edits can be reconciled automatically into the substrate?
Where should operational knowledge objects reside when this pilot outgrows the founders-charter repository?
